title: Tail Risk Spillovers in Commodity Markets: A Copula-Based Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall Approach
affiliations: Agricultural University of Athens, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of East Anglia (UEA) - School of Economic and Social Studies

detail.title: Tail Risk Spillovers in Commodity Markets: A Copula-Based Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall Approach

keywords: Crude oil and Agricultural commodity futures

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the evolving dependence structure and tail risk spillovers between crude oil and major agricultural futures (wheat, corn, and soybeans) from January 2005 to December 2023. Using a GJR-GARCH model to estimate the marginal distributions and several dynamic copulas (Student-t, Gumbel, and Rotated Gumbel) within a Generalized Autoregressive Score (GAS) framework, we examine the time-varying co-movements and asymmetries across different crisis periods, including the global financial crisis, the European debt crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the Russia–Ukraine war.We compute dynamic Value-at-Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall (ES), and hedge ratios to assess the magnitude and direction of tail risk transmission, with a special focus on lower-tail dependence. The results reveal stronger downside risk spillovers from oil to agricultural commodities during major crises, particularly for soybeans. These findings offer valuable insights into commodity market integration, portfolio diversification, and hedging strategies under extreme market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2005-2023年间原油与主要农产品期货（小麦、玉米、大豆）之间的动态依赖结构和尾部风险溢出效应。使用GJR-GARCH模型和动态copula方法，发现在重大危机期间原油向农产品（特别是大豆）的下行风险溢出更强。
AI.research_question: 原油与主要农产品期货之间的依赖结构和尾部风险溢出如何随时间演变？
AI.motivation: 理解商品市场在危机期间的联动性和风险传导机制，为投资组合多元化和对冲策略提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: GJR-GARCH模型、动态copula理论（Student-t、Gumbel、Rotated Gumbel）、广义自回归得分（GAS）框架、风险度量理论（VaR、ES）。
AI.method: 使用GJR-GARCH估计边际分布，在GAS框架内应用多种动态copula模型，计算动态VaR、ES和对冲比率，特别关注下尾依赖。
AI.findings: 在重大危机期间（全球金融危机、欧债危机、COVID-19、俄乌战争），原油向农产品的下行风险溢出更强，特别是对大豆的影响最显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了动态copula在商品市场风险溢出研究中的应用，深化了对极端市场条件下商品联动性的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在危机期间的商品投资组合管理、风险对冲和多元化策略提供了实证依据和实用指导。

title: Reconciling Consumer and Vendor Preferences for Food Safety Attributes in Dhaka Wet Markets, Bangladesh
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, independent consultant, The Kenya National Treasury, CGIAR - International Potato Center, CGIAR - International Potato Center, International Livestock Research Institute (ILRI) and CGIAR - International Potato Center

detail.title: Reconciling Consumer and Vendor Preferences for Food Safety Attributes in Dhaka Wet Markets, Bangladesh
detail.abstract: Rapid urbanization presents major challenges to urban food systems, impacting access to safe and nutritious food especially in developing countries. With the urban demand for food surging, there is a proliferation of largely unregulated vendors in the informal food sector to meet this demand. However, these vendors often work in market environments characterized by inadequate sanitation infrastructure and poor waste management processes. Coupled with low consumer and vendor awareness on food safety, this presents a high risk for the spread of foodborne diseases and a significant threat to public health. To understand both demand-and supply-side policy options for promoting food safety, this study utilizes a choice experiment approach to investigate the interplay between consumer preferences and vendor practices regarding food safety in Dhaka's urban markets. The study finds that consumers favour high-quality fresh produce and prioritize vendors with good hygiene, as well as markets with medium to high sanitation. Conversely, vendors have high preferences for markets with improved sanitation and permanent infrastructure, but show hesitation towards investments in storage improvements, underlining the need for targeted policy interventions. Both consumers and vendors have a high willingness to pay for improved market conditions that promote food quality and safety, suggesting that improving market sanitation infrastructure and establishing permanent structures to maintain the quality of fresh produce could be mutually beneficial for both types of actors. Additionally, enhancing food safety awareness among both parties is imperative, addressing the prevalent disregard for vendor hygiene and its repercussions for public health.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了达卡城市市场中消费者偏好与摊贩实践在食品安全方面的相互作用，发现消费者偏好高质量新鲜农产品和良好卫生条件的摊贩，而摊贩偏好改善的卫生设施但不愿投资存储改善。双方都愿意为改善市场条件付费，建议政策干预应关注市场卫生基础设施建设和食品安全意识提升。

title: From Delivery Apps to Courtrooms: The Struggle to Define Gig Work in India
affiliations: Nirma University, Institute of Law and Institute of Law, Nirma University

detail.title: From Delivery Apps to Courtrooms: The Struggle to Define Gig Work in India
detail.abstract: India’s food and grocery delivery apps such as Zomato, Swiggy, Blinkit, Zepto, and BigBasket have changed the rhythm of urban life. Every quick delivery tells two stories, the story of convenience for the customer and the story of struggle for the worker making it happen. These gig workers, who are often celebrated as symbols of digital progress, continue to work without job security, social benefits, or fair protection. The Code on Social Security, 2020, was expected to bridge this gap but has so far offered only limited relief. Adding to this challenge is the control of algorithms that decide who gets orders, how much they earn, and whether they can continue to work at all. This blog explores how the law can catch up with the new realities of digital labour, and why fairness and dignity must be central to India’s growing gig economy.

AI.tldr: 这篇博客分析了印度食品配送平台（如Zomato、Swiggy等）中零工工人的困境，探讨了2020年《社会保障法》的局限性以及算法控制对工人的影响，主张法律需要适应数字劳动的新现实。
AI.research_question: 法律如何适应数字劳动的新现实，确保印度零工经济中的公平和尊严？
AI.motivation: 印度食品配送应用的兴起改变了城市生活节奏，但零工工人缺乏工作保障、社会福利和公平保护，而《社会保障法》仅提供有限救济，算法控制进一步加剧了工人的困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字劳动理论、零工经济理论、算法控制理论、劳动法与社会保障理论
AI.method: 博客形式的政策分析和法律评论
AI.findings: 1. 零工工人面临工作不安全感、缺乏社会福利和公平保护；2. 《社会保障法》仅提供有限救济；3. 算法控制决定工人的订单分配、收入和就业机会；4. 现行法律未能充分适应数字劳动的新现实
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对数字劳动和零工经济中算法控制影响的理解，提出了法律适应数字劳动现实的必要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了改进零工工人权益保护的见解，强调了将公平和尊严置于零工经济核心的重要性

title: The Job Posting-Hiring Gap: Empirical Evidence and Theoretical Insights into its Causes and Consequences

detail.title: The Job Posting-Hiring Gap: Empirical Evidence and Theoretical Insights into its Causes and Consequences
detail.abstract: The rapid expansion of online recruitment has transformed how organizations signal labor demand and how policymakers gauge workforce dynamics. Yet, a growing discrepancy exists between the number of online job postings and realized hiring outcomes-a phenomenon termed the Job Posting-Hiring Gap (JPHG). Drawing on Canadian labor market data from February to August 2025, this study provides empirical evidence that postings on major platforms such as LinkedIn and Indeed substantially overstate actual employment growth. On average, employment declined slightly even as vacancy volumes rose, indicating that a significant proportion of postings do not correspond to genuine hiring activity. To explain this divergence, the paper integrates established theories in organizational and labor market research. It identifies organizational, strategic, and labor market mechanisms-such as brand signaling, pipeline maintenance, and monopsonistic frictions-that generate the gap, as well as mediators like employer attractiveness and matching efficiency. The consequences extend beyond data distortion: for job seekers, the JPHG fosters fatigue and distrust; for firms, it introduces reputational and operational inefficiencies; and for policymakers, it undermines the reliability of vacancy statistics as indicators of labor demand. By combining empirical and theoretical evidence, the study establishes the JPHG as a structural feature of digitalized labor markets and calls for a reconsideration of how vacancy data are interpreted in human resource management, organizational research, and macroeconomic policy.

AI.tldr: 本文基于加拿大劳动力市场数据，实证发现在线招聘平台上的职位发布数量显著高估实际雇佣增长，这种职位发布-雇佣差距（JPHG）是数字化劳动力市场的结构性特征。
AI.research_question: 在线招聘平台上的职位发布为何与实际雇佣结果存在显著差距？这种差距的产生机制和影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 在线招聘的快速扩张改变了组织传递劳动力需求信号的方式，但职位发布数量与真实雇佣结果之间的差距日益扩大，影响了劳动力市场数据的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合组织理论和劳动力市场研究理论，包括品牌信号传递、人才管道维护、垄断性摩擦等机制。
AI.method: 使用2025年2月至8月的加拿大劳动力市场数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 主要招聘平台（如LinkedIn和Indeed）上的职位发布显著高估了实际就业增长，即使在职位空缺量上升时就业仍略有下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了JPHG作为数字化劳动力市场结构性特征的理论地位，识别了产生差距的组织、战略和劳动力市场机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 对求职者、企业和政策制定者都具有重要实践意义：求职者面临疲劳和不信任，企业面临声誉和运营效率问题，政策制定者需要重新评估职位空缺数据的可靠性。

title: BRICS: A Potential Challenge to The U.S. Dollar Dominance

detail.title: BRICS: A Potential Challenge to The U.S. Dollar Dominance
detail.abstract: This research paper delves into the shifting realignments of global power structures within the framework of the New World Order, focusing on the diplomatic coalition of BRICS and its potential threat for the U.S. dollar dominance. The global transformation arise from three major crises the 2008 financial crisis, the Covid-19 crisis, and most recently the energy and commodity challenges in the aftermath of Russia-Ukrain war. These events led to a shared conviction thatthe form of monetary framework, pursued over the past decade is no longer sustainable. Consequently, a paradigm shift is underway, leading towards multolateralism through the emergence of three major hubs of globalisation. One controlled by the U.S. and North America. Western Europe is the second and Asia, dominated by China is third in the row. Therefore, it became very crucial for the global south to redefine their positions in this new geo-economic map either as a satellite or a strategic partner to the rest of the global economy. Traditonally, future of the International system is perceived through two assumptions: first, that emerging powers would integrate themselves into the existing global governance framework, and second, U.S. led institutions would be would remain dominant. However, the BRICS nations, have been forming revisionist alliances and establishing new institutions, challenging the dominant role of the U.S. in global affairs. The research is structured as follows: The initial section introduces the BRICS and The Existing Monitory Framework. Subsequent sections delve into the analytical framework in the context of pathways for BRICS towards de-dollarization, the evolution of BRICS, possible challenges for BRICS towards de-dollarization, its impact on the status quo, and the US response. The concluding part summarizes key insights and provides recommendations for future possibilities.

AI.motivation: 全球三大危机（2008年金融危机、新冠疫情、俄乌战争后的能源危机）表明现有货币框架不可持续，推动全球权力结构重新调整和多边主义范式转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新世界秩序理论、全球权力结构理论、去美元化理论、多边主义理论
AI.method: 分析框架研究，包括金砖国家去美元化路径、金砖国家演变、去美元化面临的挑战、对现状的影响以及美国应对策略的分析
AI.findings: 金砖国家正在形成修正主义联盟并建立新机构，挑战美国在全球事务中的主导地位；全球南方国家需要重新定义其在地缘经济地图中的位置；出现了三大全球化中心（美国主导的北美、西欧、中国主导的亚洲）
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统国际体系的两个假设：新兴国家会融入现有全球治理框架、美国主导机构将保持主导地位；提出了多边主义范式转变的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球南方国家提供了重新定位的战略建议；分析了金砖国家去美元化的可行路径和挑战；为政策制定者提供了应对全球权力结构变化的参考

title: Geopolitical Risks and Energy Prices: Impacts of Russia-Ukraine Conflict
affiliations: Florida International University (FIU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Geopolitical Risks and Energy Prices: Impacts of Russia-Ukraine Conflict
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of the Russia-Ukraine conflict on domestic energy prices across 85 countries using a structural factor-augmented vector autoregression framework. The main innovation is the construction of a conflict-specific shock from the common component of geopolitical risks in Russia and Ukraine, enabling a precise identification of the direct risk channel versus indirect global channels. The findings reveal a significant heterogeneity across countries in the transmission of shocks. For highly exposed European nations like Moldova, Austria, and Latvia, the direct geopolitical risk channel is a primary driver of energy price volatility, accounting for 20-25% of price fluctuations. In contrast, for major economies like Germany and the United States, impacts of the conflict are transmitted indirectly, with global economic activity and world oil prices explaining over 50% of energy price movements. The analysis provides a causally identified account of how a major geopolitical event propagates through the global economy.

AI.tldr: 本文使用结构因子增强向量自回归框架研究俄乌冲突对85个国家国内能源价格的影响，通过构建冲突特定冲击来区分直接地缘政治风险渠道和间接全球渠道，发现不同国家间冲击传导存在显著异质性。
AI.research_question: 俄乌冲突如何通过直接地缘政治风险渠道和间接全球渠道影响各国国内能源价格？
AI.motivation: 理解重大地缘政治事件在全球经济中的传播机制，特别是区分直接风险渠道和间接全球渠道对能源价格的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构因子增强向量自回归框架，地缘政治风险理论，全球能源市场传导机制。
AI.method: 使用85个国家的数据，构建冲突特定冲击（基于俄罗斯和乌克兰地缘政治风险的共同成分），采用结构因子增强向量自回归模型进行因果识别分析。
AI.findings: 1）冲击传导在不同国家间存在显著异质性；2）对高度暴露的欧洲国家（如摩尔多瓦、奥地利、拉脱维亚），直接地缘政治风险渠道是主要驱动因素，解释20-25%的价格波动；3）对主要经济体（如德国、美国），冲突影响主要通过间接渠道传导，全球经济活动和国际油价解释超过50%的能源价格变动。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）开发了识别地缘政治冲突特定冲击的方法；2）区分了直接风险渠道和间接全球渠道的传导机制；3）提供了重大地缘政治事件在全球经济中传播的因果识别证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者理解地缘政治风险对能源市场的影响提供实证依据；2）帮助各国根据自身暴露程度制定相应的能源安全政策；3）为能源价格风险管理提供理论支持。

title: Licensing Negotiation Groups: The New Antitrust Kid on the SEPs Block
affiliations: Università degli Studi della Basilicata

detail.title: Licensing Negotiation Groups: The New Antitrust Kid on the SEPs Block
detail.abstract: The European approach to standard essential patent (SEP) licensing increasingly resembles a form of therapeutic obstinacy. Even before the Draft Regulation was definitively withdrawn, a new issue had already taken center stage in the policy debate. As part of the ongoing review of the Technology Transfer Block Exemption Regulation (TTBER) and the related Guidelines (TTGs), the European Commission is considering providing guidance on the competition law assessment of licensing negotiation groups (LNGs). The recent draft revision of the TTGs, which was preceded by an informal guidance letter concerning the establishment of the Automotive Licensing Negotiation Group, illustrates the Commission's responsiveness to implementers' concerns. Thus, in what feels like a Groundhog Day, the same arguments, justifications, and objectives that were hotly debated in connection with the Draft Regulation have resurfaced. Indeed, much like the rationale underlying the SEP regulatory proposal, a favourable antitrust assessment of LNGs is intended to address a perceived holdup problem by promoting a solution that redistributes value from SEP holders to implementers. Against this backdrop, the paper examines these implementers' alliances under competition law and explores their implications within the current SEP licensing framework.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧洲标准必要专利（SEP）许可政策中出现的许可谈判小组（LNGs）现象，认为其类似于治疗性顽固，旨在通过反垄断评估将价值从SEP持有者重新分配给实施者。
AI.research_question: 在竞争法框架下如何评估许可谈判小组（LNGs），以及它们在当前SEP许可框架中的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 欧洲委员会正在考虑为许可谈判小组（LNGs）的反垄断评估提供指导，这反映了对实施者关切的响应，但引发了与已撤回的SEP监管提案类似的争论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于标准必要专利（SEP）许可理论、反垄断法和价值分配理论，分析LNGs对专利持有者和实施者之间权力平衡的影响。
AI.method: 政策分析和法律文本分析，考察欧洲委员会的技术转让集体豁免条例（TTBER）和相关指南（TTGs）的修订过程。
AI.findings: LNGs的反垄断评估旨在解决感知的劫持问题，但可能重复SEP监管提案中的价值重新分配争议。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对SEP许可中集体谈判机制的理论理解，揭示了政策制定中的路径依赖和重复模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于LNGs竞争法评估的见解，帮助平衡专利持有者和实施者的利益。

title: Does the Search for Stability Compromise Bank Competition?

detail.title: Does the Search for Stability Compromise Bank Competition?
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the short and long run effects of macroprudential policies on banks competition in two distinct markets: traditional intermediation and fee based activities. Drawing on the experience of Asian banking systems between the Asian Financial Crisis and the COVID-19 pandemic, we develop a novel adaptation of Bolt and Humphrey’s competition–efficiency model that enables us to distinguish between the competition determinants across different markets and time horizons. Our results are robust to alternative specifications and reveal that banks adjust quickly in the short run, when competition is relatively high, but that frequent policy changes are costly in the long run as they increase uncertainty. We also find that effects vary in magnitude and direction across markets, highlighting the need for market-specific policy design and careful calibration of reform timing.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了宏观审慎政策对银行在传统中介业务和收费业务两个市场中竞争的短期和长期影响。基于亚洲金融危机至新冠疫情期间的亚洲银行体系经验，开发了Bolt和Humphrey竞争-效率模型的新变体，能够区分不同市场和时间跨度的竞争决定因素。研究发现银行在短期调整迅速，但频繁政策变化在长期会增加不确定性成本，且政策效果在不同市场间存在差异。

AI.motivation: 理解宏观审慎政策在不同银行市场和不同时间跨度下的差异化影响，为政策制定提供更精准的依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bolt和Humphrey的竞争-效率模型，开发了能够区分不同市场和时间跨度的竞争决定因素的新模型变体。
AI.method: 利用亚洲金融危机至新冠疫情期间的亚洲银行体系数据，采用改进的竞争-效率模型进行实证分析。

title: Optimal Capital Taxation with Borrowing Constraints and Entrepreneurial Heterogeneity
affiliations: Università di Roma "Tor Vergata", University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and LUISS Guido Carli - Department of Economics

detail.title: Optimal Capital Taxation with Borrowing Constraints and Entrepreneurial Heterogeneity

publicationDetails.journalName: CEIS: Centre for Economic & International Studies Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the optimal taxation of labor and various forms of capital in a model with entrepreneurial heterogeneity and financial frictions as in Itskhoki and Moll (2019a). We consider both a closed economy, populated by workers that buy corporate bonds, and a small open economy with hand-to-mouth workers where entrepreneurs finance capital by using their wealth and by borrowing abroad. The optimal fiscal policy differs depending on whether we consider the closed economy or the small open economy. In the former the taxes on labor and pure capital should be positive, while the tax on capital income should be zero. The wealth tax levied on workers and entrepreneurs and the pure capital tax levied on firms are equivalent fiscal instruments. When we consider a small open economy, we find that the pure capital tax should be set to zero but both the capital income tax and the labor tax should be positive. In this case the capital income tax and the wealth tax are perfect substitutes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在存在企业家异质性和金融摩擦的经济模型中，对劳动力和各种形式资本的最优税收政策。研究发现，封闭经济和小型开放经济的最优税收结构存在显著差异：封闭经济中劳动税和纯资本税应为正，资本所得税应为零；小型开放经济中纯资本税应为零，而资本所得税和劳动税应为正。
AI.research_question: 在存在企业家异质性和金融摩擦的经济中，如何最优地对劳动力和各种形式的资本征税？
AI.motivation: 基于Itskhoki和Moll（2019a）的模型，探讨不同类型经济体中税收政策的最优设计，特别是在金融摩擦和企业家异质性背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: Itskhoki和Moll（2019a）的企业家异质性和金融摩擦模型，分析封闭经济和小型开放经济两种情境。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，比较封闭经济（工人购买公司债券）和小型开放经济（工人为手到口消费者，企业家通过财富和国外借款融资）的最优税收结构。
AI.findings: 1. 封闭经济：劳动税和纯资本税应为正，资本所得税应为零；财富税和纯资本税是等效工具。2. 小型开放经济：纯资本税应为零，资本所得税和劳动税应为正；资本所得税和财富税是完美替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了最优税收理论，阐明了在不同经济结构下（封闭vs开放）资本和劳动税收的最优组合，揭示了税收工具之间的替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在不同经济环境下设计税收政策的理论指导，特别是在处理企业家异质性和金融摩擦时的税收工具选择。

title: Beyond the Gender Binary: Wage Inequality and Occupational Segregation among Transgender and Nonbinary Workers
affiliations: , York University and Brock University

detail.title: Beyond the Gender Binary: Wage Inequality and Occupational Segregation among Transgender and Nonbinary Workers
detail.abstract: This study examines labor market disparities across gender identities in Canada using data from the 2021 Canadian Census, the first national census to identify transgender and nonbinary individuals. We analyze employment probabilities, work hours, and hourly wages among six gender groups: cisgender men, cisgender women, transgender men, transgender women, and nonbinary individuals assigned male or female at birth. Transgender and nonbinary individuals are 8-14 percentage points less likely to be employed than cisgender men and earn 20-30 percent lower hourly wages on average. After adjusting for demographic, occupational, and industrial characteristics, earnings gaps remain substantial-approximately 8-17 percentand are largest for nonbinary individuals assigned female at birth. Subgroup analyses reveal pronounced heterogeneity across occupations: wage gaps are smallest in health-related fields but largest in management and leadership positions, where gender minorities are also underrepresented. Transgender men fare relatively better in male-dominated fields such as trades and manufacturing, while nonbinary individuals show higher representation in arts and education. Oaxaca-Blinder decompositions indicate that about half of the overall wage gap is explained by differences in observable characteristics, with the remainder unexplained. The findings document persistent and uneven economic disadvantages for gender-diverse populations and highlight occupational contexts where barriers to inclusion are most pronounced.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用2021年加拿大人口普查数据，首次在全国范围内分析跨性别和非二元性别群体的劳动力市场差异。研究发现跨性别和非二元性别群体就业概率比顺性别男性低8-14个百分点，小时工资低20-30%。调整人口统计、职业和行业特征后，工资差距仍达8-17%，其中出生时被指定为女性的非二元性别群体差距最大。
AI.research_question: 加拿大不同性别认同群体在劳动力市场（就业概率、工作时间、小时工资）方面存在哪些差异？这些差异在不同职业领域有何异质性？
AI.motivation: 2021年加拿大人口普查首次识别跨性别和非二元性别个体，为研究性别多样性群体的经济不平等提供了独特机会。现有研究主要关注顺性别男女差异，对性别少数群体的经济状况了解有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场歧视理论、职业隔离理论、人力资本理论，使用Oaxaca-Blinder分解方法分析工资差距的可解释和不可解释部分。
AI.method: 使用2021年加拿大人口普查数据，分析六个性别群体：顺性别男性、顺性别女性、跨性别男性、跨性别女性、出生时被指定为男性或女性的非二元性别个体。采用回归分析和Oaxaca-Blinder分解。
AI.findings: 跨性别和非二元性别群体就业概率比顺性别男性低8-14%，小时工资低20-30%。调整后工资差距仍为8-17%，非二元性别（出生时女性）差距最大。职业异质性明显：医疗领域差距最小，管理和领导职位差距最大。跨性别男性在男性主导领域表现较好，非二元性别在艺术和教育领域代表性较高。约一半工资差距可由可观测特征解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在全国普查层面系统分析性别多样性群体的劳动力市场差异，扩展了性别与劳动力市场研究的理论框架，揭示了职业情境在塑造不平等中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性干预的依据，特别是在管理和领导职位等不平等最严重的领域。帮助企业制定更具包容性的人力资源政策，促进性别多样性群体的经济融入。

title: Investor Behavior in the Pre-Opening: The Role of Price Impact and Strategic Interaction

detail.title: Investor Behavior in the Pre-Opening: The Role of Price Impact and Strategic Interaction
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a framework for analyzing the portfolio strategies of investors who participate in the pre-opening and regular market sessions. Investors act strategically, recognizing that their pre-opening orders influence the asset's opening price. I examine the roles of key factors, such as the characteristics of price impact, number of market participants, investor heterogeneity, risk aversion, and the presence of retail investor, in shaping portfolio strategies and their implications for capital gains and stock price volatility during the regular trading session. The results shed light on the nuanced effects of the pre-opening session on the broader dynamics of financial markets.

title: Product Assortment Effects of Mergers
affiliations: Koc University

detail.title: Product Assortment Effects of Mergers
detail.abstract: The effect of mergers on product assortments is ambiguous. Reduced competition may disincentivize firms from offering a wide variety of options, while efficiency gains may lower the cost of introducing new offerings. This study empirically analyzes the impact of mergers on product assortments in the car rental industry using three cross-sections of airport-brand level data before and after the Hertz-Dollar Thrifty and Avis Budget-Payless mergers. The results indicate that mergers generally lead to a decreased growth in the number of car rental offerings, particularly for specialized vehicle types such as SUVs and vans, suggesting a decline in assortment diversity. However, this effect is not observed in larger markets, implying lower anti-competitive effects. The study discusses the policy implications for merger regulation, emphasizing the importance of considering market-specific factors.

title: Global Oil Prices and Metro Ridership in the Greater Manila Area: A Structural Vector Autoregression Analysis
affiliations: Asian Institute of Management, Asian Institute of Management and Asian Institute of Management

detail.title: Global Oil Prices and Metro Ridership in the Greater Manila Area: A Structural Vector Autoregression Analysis

declarations.funderStatement: This study is funded by Konrad-Adenauer-Stiftung.

detail.abstract: Global oil price volatility has historically influenced economic stability, with major shocks in the 1970s, during the First Gulf War, and in 2008 driving global inflation. While developed economies often cushion these effects through efficient public transport systems, developing countries with informal and fragmented networks face greater vulnerability. Despite growing recognition of sustainable mobility’s role in reducing emissions and improving urban livability, limited research explores behavioral responses to oil price shocks in the Global South, particularly in Southeast Asia. This paper examines the impact of global oil price shocks on public transport ridership and macroeconomic variables in the Philippines using Structural Vector Autoregression (SVAR) analysis. Focusing on Metro Rail Transit (MRT) and Light Rail Transit (LRT) ridership in the Greater Manila Area from January 2005 to December 2019, the study analyzes the effects of a one-standard deviation increase in global oil prices. Results suggest a delayed but positive response in metro ridership, assuming gradual commuter shifts from private to public transport as fuel prices rise. By providing empirical evidence from a developing country context, this study contributes to understanding oil price shocks and transport behavior in the Global South.

title: A Global Systems Perspective on Food Demand, Deforestation and Agricultural Sustainability
affiliations: Ecole Polytechnique, Palaiseau, Ecole Polytechnique, Palaiseau, Capital Fund Management and Peking University - College of Urban and Environmental Sciences

detail.title: A Global Systems Perspective on Food Demand, Deforestation and Agricultural Sustainability
detail.abstract: Feeding a larger and wealthier global population without transgressing ecological limits is increasingly challenging, as rising food demand-especially for animal products-intensifies pressure on ecosystems, accelerates deforestation, and erodes biodiversity and soil health. We develop a stylized, spatially explicit global model that links exogenous food-demand trajectories to crop and livestock production, land conversion, and feedbacks from ecosystem integrity that, in turn, shape future yields and land needs. Calibrated to post-1960 trends in population, income, yields, input use, and land use, the model reproduces the joint rise of crop and meat demand and the associated expansion and intensification of agriculture. We use it to compare business-as-usual, supply-side, demand-side, and mixed-policy scenarios. Three results stand out. First, productivity-oriented supply-side measures (e.g. reduced chemical inputs, organic conversion, lower livestock density) often trigger compensatory land expansion that undermines ecological gains-so that supply-side action alone cannot halt deforestation or widespread degradation. Second, demand-side change, particularly reduced meat consumption, consistently relieves both intensification and expansion pressures; in our simulations, only substantial demand reductions (on the order of 40% of projected excess demand by 2100) deliver simultaneous increases in forest area and declines in degraded land. Third, integrated policy portfolios that jointly constrain land conversion, temper input intensification, and curb demand outperform any single lever. Together, these findings clarify the system-level trade-offs that frustrate piecemeal interventions and identify the policy combinations most likely to keep global food provision within ecological limits.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个空间明确的全球模型，分析不同政策情景下粮食系统与生态系统的相互作用。研究发现：仅靠供给侧措施会引发补偿性土地扩张；需求侧措施特别是减少肉类消费能有效缓解生态压力；综合政策组合效果最佳。
AI.research_question: 如何在不超出生态极限的情况下满足全球不断增长的粮食需求？不同政策干预（供给侧、需求侧、综合政策）对农业扩张、集约化和生态完整性的影响如何？
AI.motivation: 全球人口增长和收入增加导致粮食需求上升，特别是动物产品需求加剧了生态系统压力、加速森林砍伐、侵蚀生物多样性和土壤健康，迫切需要找到可持续的粮食供应方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于粮食需求与农业生产、土地利用、生态系统反馈之间的动态关系，构建空间明确的全球模型，分析系统层面的权衡关系。
AI.method: 开发了一个经过校准的、空间明确的全球模型，将外生粮食需求轨迹与作物和畜牧业生产、土地转换以及生态系统完整性反馈联系起来，模拟1960年后的趋势并比较不同政策情景。
AI.findings: 1）仅靠供给侧措施会引发补偿性土地扩张；2）需求侧改变特别是减少肉类消费能缓解集约化和扩张压力；3）综合政策组合（限制土地转换、控制投入集约化、抑制需求）效果最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了粮食系统中系统层面的权衡关系，解释了零散干预措施效果有限的原因，为理解政策组合的协同效应提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了最有可能将全球粮食供应控制在生态极限内的政策组合，为政策制定者提供了具体的行动指南，强调需求侧管理特别是减少肉类消费的重要性。

title: Flexible Work Arrangements (Flextime, Telecommuting, Compressed Workweeks) and Employee Productivity in Murang’a Level 5 Hospital
affiliations: Zetech University, Zetech University and Zetech University

detail.title: Flexible Work Arrangements (Flextime, Telecommuting, Compressed Workweeks) and Employee Productivity in Murang’a Level 5 Hospital

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare that this research was not influenced by anyone and it was my research project for completion of my masters degree.
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare I got the approval to conduct this research through NACOSTI and individual participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was fully funded through my own savings and no organization provided any incentives.

detail.abstract: This study examined the relationship between employee productivity and flexible work arrangements (FWAs), such as compressed workweeks, flextime, and telecommuting at Murang'a Level 5 Hospital, a Kenyan rural public healthcare facility dealing with a high patient load and staff shortage challenges. Job Demands-Resources (JD-R) Model, Herzberg's Two-Factor Theory, and Social Exchange Theory were used. A mixed-methods approach was utilised, surveying 205 employees from a population of 421 selected through stratified sampling. SPSS was used to perform analysis for both qualitative and quantitative data, including thematic coding and multiple regression. Key findings from 186 respondents (90.7% response rate) showed that telecommuting (β = 0.176, p = 0.005), flextime (β = 0.421, p < 0.001), and compressed workweeks (β = 0.269, p < 0.001) had positive effects on employee productivity. The regression analysis yielded R² values of 0.046, 0.236, and 0.107, accounting for approximately 4.6%, 23.6% and 10.7% of the employee productivity variance, respectively. The findings informed hospital management, healthcare professionals, and policymakers on optimising hybrid FWAs to improved service delivery, aligning with Kenya's Vision 2030, Murang'a County 2022-2027 objectives, and Sustainable Development Goal 3. The study extended existing literature by demonstrating variations in FWA effectiveness across staff categories, with flextime showing stronger impacts in non-clinical roles compared to clinical ones, where physical presence limited telecommuting. This addressed a gap in Kenyan public hospitals, where previous research primarily focused on urban and nonhealthcare settings, and highlighted the significance of applying the findings to similar rural facilities while cautioning against direct generalization without considering local infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了肯尼亚农村公立医院中弹性工作安排（包括远程办公、弹性工作时间和压缩工作周）与员工生产率的关系。研究发现三种弹性工作安排都对员工生产率有显著正向影响，其中弹性工作时间影响最大。研究填补了肯尼亚公立医院特别是农村医疗机构的空白。

title: The Role of Psychological Safety in Intelligent Business Systems of the Future -Implications and Implementation
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: The Role of Psychological Safety in Intelligent Business Systems of the Future -Implications and Implementation
detail.abstract: This paper explores the critical role of psychological safety in the development and operation of intelligent business systems (IBS) of the future. Psychological safety, defined as a shared belief that a team is safe for interpersonal risk-taking, has shown to improve innovation, learning, and performance [1][2]. In IBS, where human-machine interaction is prominent, fostering psychological safety becomes vital to ensure seamless collaboration between employees and intelligent technologies [9][10]. The fast-paced evolution of AI-driven environments demands that employees feel secure in expressing ideas, raising concerns, and embracing experimentation without fear of judgment or reprisal [23]. A quantitative research methodology was employed involving a survey administered to 500 employees across multinational corporations that have adopted intelligent systems. Key constructs such as psychological safety, trust in AI, team collaboration, and perceived team performance were measured using a 7-point Likert scale ranging from 1 = Strongly Disagree to 7 = Strongly Agree [29]. This format was chosen to capture the nuances of participants' perceptions across key constructs. Data analysis was conducted using structural equation modelling (SEM) to uncover the relationships among these variables. The findings reveal that psychological safety significantly enhances team collaboration and trust in AI, which in turn drive improved team performance in intelligent business environments [26]. These insights led to the development of the Integrated Psychological Safety in Intelligent Business Systems (IPS-IBS) Framework; a novel model designed to guide organizations in embedding psychological safety as a core principle within their intelligent systems strategy [23]. A visual representation of this framework is provided to support practical implementation and policy development.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了心理安全感在未来智能商业系统发展中的关键作用。通过500名跨国公司员工的调查发现，心理安全感显著增强团队协作和对AI的信任，进而提升团队绩效，并提出了IPS-IBS整合框架。

AI.motivation: 随着AI驱动环境的快速发展，确保员工在表达想法、提出关切和进行实验时感到安全至关重要，以促进人机无缝协作。

AI.method: 定量研究方法，对500名跨国公司员工进行问卷调查，使用7点李克特量表测量心理安全感、AI信任、团队协作和团队绩效等构念，采用结构方程模型进行数据分析。
AI.findings: 心理安全感显著增强团队协作和对AI的信任，进而驱动智能商业环境中团队绩效的提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了整合心理安全感与智能商业系统的IPS-IBS框架，扩展了心理安全感理论在AI环境中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了将心理安全感嵌入智能系统战略的实践指导框架，支持政策制定和实际实施。

The focal points of scrutiny include technology, motivation, environment, games, interests, achievement, and development. The synthesis of findings not only illuminates critical facets but also addresses lacunae and outlines future research prospects within the realm of AR in education. This comprehensive review stands as a valuable compass for educators, researchers, and policymakers navigating the dynamic terrain of educational

title: Output Transparency: Differentiating Human and AI Creativity through Legal Reforms
affiliations: The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Output Transparency: Differentiating Human and AI Creativity through Legal Reforms
detail.abstract: The advent of artificial intelligence (AI) has presented our legal system with a profound new dilemma. Public confidence in the capacity of AI to generate content is growing quickly, nearly apace with advancements in the technology itself. Yet, as AI-generated content masquerading as human-authored increasingly floods online platforms, our ability to tell the difference is diminishing. This widespread concealment of AI’s role in content creation has unleashed a cascade of harms for individuals as well as society at large. This article exposes the law’s failure to regulate AI concealment, a legal vacuum that permits the proliferation of such concealment. To address this challenge, we must first theoretically interrogate why it is important to distinguish AI-generated content from human-authored works. Building on this theoretical foundation, we can then consider the feasibility of adopting a robust legal standard to regulate AI concealment. To this end, the article advances a theory of “differentiated creativity”. This theory clarifies the fundamental differences between human creative processes—rooted in human intentionality, emotional expression, and control—and those of AI. Based on this theory, the article then proposes “output transparency” as a new legal standard enabling clear differentiation between human and AI contributions. To operationalize output transparency, the article advocates two key legal reforms: requiring technology companies to watermark AI-generated content, and obligating authors to provide proper explanations of the modifications they have made to such content. These proposed reforms would protect human adaptations of AI outputs, ensure a clear distinction between human and machine contributions, and enhance transparency across creative sectors. By implementing these reforms, the legal system can more effectively safeguard and foster the creative potential of both humans and AI, promoting balanced and ethical integration of technology in society.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI内容伪装成人类创作的法律监管缺失问题，提出'差异化创造力'理论，并建议通过'输出透明度'标准和法律改革来区分人类与AI创作。
AI.research_question: 如何通过法律标准有效区分和监管AI生成内容与人类创作内容？
AI.motivation: AI生成内容冒充人类创作的现象日益普遍，导致个人和社会遭受一系列伤害，而现行法律在监管AI内容伪装方面存在真空。
AI.theoretical_framework: 差异化创造力理论 - 强调人类创作过程基于意图性、情感表达和控制，与AI创作存在根本差异。
AI.method: 理论分析和法律标准构建，提出'输出透明度'作为新的法律标准。
AI.findings: 现行法律未能有效监管AI内容伪装，需要通过法律改革来确保人类与AI贡献的明确区分。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了'差异化创造力'理论，为区分人类与AI创作提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出两项关键法律改革：要求科技公司对AI生成内容添加水印，要求作者说明对AI内容的修改，以增强创意领域的透明度。

title: Quantum Machine Learning – The Black Swan and Grey Rhino Problem : Are we Building the Next Financial Crisis?
affiliations: Independent researcher

detail.title: Quantum Machine Learning – The Black Swan and Grey Rhino Problem : Are we Building the Next Financial Crisis?
detail.abstract: Recent advances in quantum computing have demonstrated improved performance in financial prediction tasks, with IBM and HSBC reporting a 34% improvement in algorithmic trading fill probability predictions. However, analysis of the published results reveals a concerning pattern: quantum circuits with inherent Gaussian-like noise characteristics systematically smooth input distributions, progressively eliminating the fat-tailed features that signal rare, high-impact market events. This paper examines the structural parallels between this tail-filtering mechanism and the pre-2008 financial crisis, when Value-at-Risk models similarly optimised for Gaussian assumptions whilst systematically underestimating catastrophic tail risk. Drawing on Taleb's theory of fat-tailed distributions and the concept of Grey Rhino events (predictable but ignored threats), I argue that quantum-enhanced machine learning may replicate the exact failure mode that contributed to systemic collapse in 2008. The evidence for this tail-filtering effect is visible in IBM-HSBC's own published histograms, which show progressive Gaussianisation with increased circuit depth. Whilst quantum ML researchers and financial institutions have likely considered these implications, this paper documents the observable warning signs to discharge an epistemic obligation: if quantumenhanced models exhibit catastrophic failures during future market stress events, the mechanism will have been identified, and the pattern will have been visible in the data from the outset.

AI.tldr: 量子计算在金融预测中虽然提升了性能，但存在系统性过滤尾部风险的隐患，可能重现2008年金融危机的失败模式。
AI.research_question: 量子增强的机器学习是否会复制导致2008年系统性崩溃的尾部风险低估失败模式？
AI.motivation: IBM和HSBC报告量子计算在算法交易中提升了34%的填充概率预测性能，但分析发现量子电路会系统性地平滑输入分布，消除预示罕见高影响市场事件的厚尾特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Taleb的厚尾分布理论和灰犀牛事件概念，分析量子电路与VaR模型在尾部风险处理上的结构相似性。
AI.method: 分析IBM-HSBC已发表的结果直方图，观察量子电路深度增加时的渐进高斯化现象。
AI.findings: 量子电路具有固有的类高斯噪声特性，会系统性地平滑输入分布，逐步消除厚尾特征，这与2008年前VaR模型对高斯假设的优化相似。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了量子增强机器学习中尾部风险过滤的机制，建立了与历史金融危机的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构和量子ML研究者提供了可观测的预警信号，有助于预防未来市场压力事件中的灾难性失败。

title: Shaping psychologists' professional identity during a period of crisis: An existential-dialectical approach
affiliations: Riga Stradins University, Riga Stradins University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Shaping psychologists' professional identity during a period of crisis: An existential-dialectical approach
detail.abstract: This study explored how the professional identity of psychologists was shaped during the crisis period characterised by the COVID-19 pandemic, accelerated digitalisation, and the war in Ukraine. Drawing on an existential-dialectical framework, the research examined how psychologists navigated practical contradictions and existential tensions involving meaning, purpose, and professional significance during widespread disruption. The qualitative study included 45 experienced Latvian psychologists (M = 47.13 years, 87% women) who began practising before the pandemic. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews conducted in October-November 2022. Reflexive thematic analysis was employed to identify patterns of professional identity transformation, with particular attention to dialectical tensions and existential challenges. Five themes emerged: (1) reconciling traditional practices with crisis-driven changes, where remote work created boundary challenges while proving effective; (2) balancing emotional vulnerability and professional responsibility, as rising demand intensified both strain and professional value; (3) navigating isolation and collaboration through enhanced supervision and peer support; (4) evolving professional practices through creativity and functional adaptations; and (5) experiencing professional growth through strengthened commitment despite initial uncertainty. The findings demonstrate that professional identity transformation during crises involves navigating universal dialectical tensions while addressing existential challenges of meaning and purpose. Psychologists adaptively integrated reflective practices, digital competencies, and self-care strategies. The study contributes to professional identity literature by demonstrating that crises serve as catalysts for comprehensive identity transformation, fostering more adaptive, reflective, and resilient professional identities through resolving both practical contradictions and existential uncertainties.

title: ChatGPT Referrals to E-Commerce Websites: Do LLMs Outperform Traditional Channels?
affiliations: University of Hamburg and

detail.title: ChatGPT Referrals to E-Commerce Websites: Do LLMs Outperform Traditional Channels?
detail.abstract: We investigate the performance of organic Large Language Model traffic (oLLM) versus traditional digital channels in e-commerce. Analyzing 12 months of first-party data from 973 websites with $20 billion combined revenue, we examine over 50,000 transactions from ChatGPT referrals alongside 164 million transactions from traditional channels. Using regression models that account for data sparsity, we assess financial metrics (conversion rate, average order value, revenue per session) and engagement metrics (bounce rate, session duration, page views). Results contradict widespread expectations of oLLM superiority. Organic LLM traffic underperforms all traditional channels except paid social media across key financial metrics. While oLLM achieves favorable bounce rates, indicating relevance, it generates lower conversion rates and revenue per session than Google's paid and organic search channels. The performance gap persists across extensive robustness checks varying aggregation periods, observation thresholds, and website samples. Despite current underperformance, oLLM shows positive trajectories. Conversion rates improved over the observation period, though declining average order values offset some gains. Time-trend analyses suggest gradual convergence with traditional channels, but projections indicate oLLM will not achieve parity with organic search within the next year. These findings challenge narratives of LLMs as immediate "Google killers" while suggesting potential for long-term channel evolution.

title: Republic Act No. 11058

detail.title: Republic Act No. 11058
detail.abstract: This paper provides a critical analysis of Republic Act No. 11058, also known as the Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Law of 2018. The study examines the law’s objectives, key provisions, strengths, and weaknesses in ensuring safe and healthy working conditions for Filipino workers. RA 11058 institutionalizes safety compliance by mandating employers to provide proper training, equipment, and hazard prevention systems, while also empowering workers to uphold their rights. Despite its progressive framework, the implementation of the law faces challenges such as limited inspection capacity of the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE), financial burdens on small and medium enterprises (SMEs), and low awareness among informal workers. The analysis concludes that while RA 11058 significantly advances labor protection in the Philippines, greater institutional support, awareness campaigns, and incentives for compliance are needed to achieve its full potential in promoting workplace safety and productivity.

title: The Impact of Workplace Psychological Violence on the Safety Attitude of Operating Room Nurses: The Mediation of Psychological Resilience
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Impact of Workplace Psychological Violence on the Safety Attitude of Operating Room Nurses: The Mediation of Psychological Resilience
detail.abstract: Background: Workplace psychological violence erodes OR nurses’ professional identity, fuels burnout and threatens patient safety. Psychological resilience may buffer these effects, yet its role in linking violence to safety attitudes remains unclear. Methods: A 2024 cross-sectional survey recruited 296 OR nurses from seven Shanghai tertiary hospitals. Participants completed the WPVB, CD-RISC and SAQ-OR instruments. Spearman correlations and Process Model 4 were used to test the mediating effect of resilience on the violence–attitude pathway. Results: Higher violence exposure was associated with lower resilience (r = –0.363) and poorer safety attitudes (r = –0.313), whereas resilience strongly predicted better attitudes (r = 0.500). Resilience accounted for 47.7 % of the total effect of violence on safety attitudes. Conclusion: Psychological violence is prevalent among OR nurses; strengthening resilience and a positive safety culture may mitigate its detrimental impact on safety performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨手术室护士遭受职场心理暴力对其安全态度的影响，以及心理弹性在这一关系中的中介作用。研究发现心理暴力会降低护士的心理弹性，进而恶化安全态度，心理弹性解释了47.7%的总效应。
AI.research_question: 心理弹性在手术室护士遭受职场心理暴力与安全态度关系中的中介作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 职场心理暴力侵蚀手术室护士的职业认同，加剧职业倦怠，威胁患者安全。心理弹性可能缓冲这些影响，但其在暴力与安全态度关系中的作用尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理弹性的保护作用理论和职场暴力对医护人员影响的现有研究框架
AI.method: 2024年横断面调查，从上海7家三甲医院招募296名手术室护士，使用WPVB、CD-RISC和SAQ-OR量表，采用Spearman相关分析和Process Model 4检验中介效应
AI.findings: 较高的暴力暴露与较低的心理弹性（r = -0.363）和较差的安全态度（r = -0.313）相关，而心理弹性强烈预测更好的态度（r = 0.500）。心理弹性解释了47.7%的暴力对安全态度的总效应。

title: Shaping psychologists' professional identity during a period of crisis: An existential-dialectical approach
affiliations: Riga Stradins University, Riga Stradins University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Shaping psychologists' professional identity during a period of crisis: An existential-dialectical approach
detail.abstract: This study explored how the professional identity of psychologists was shaped during the crisis period characterised by the COVID-19 pandemic, accelerated digitalisation, and the war in Ukraine. Drawing on an existential-dialectical framework, the research examined how psychologists navigated practical contradictions and existential tensions involving meaning, purpose, and professional significance during widespread disruption. The qualitative study included 45 experienced Latvian psychologists (M = 47.13 years, 87% women) who began practising before the pandemic. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews conducted in October-November 2022. Reflexive thematic analysis was employed to identify patterns of professional identity transformation, with particular attention to dialectical tensions and existential challenges. Five themes emerged: (1) reconciling traditional practices with crisis-driven changes, where remote work created boundary challenges while proving effective; (2) balancing emotional vulnerability and professional responsibility, as rising demand intensified both strain and professional value; (3) navigating isolation and collaboration through enhanced supervision and peer support; (4) evolving professional practices through creativity and functional adaptations; and (5) experiencing professional growth through strengthened commitment despite initial uncertainty. The findings demonstrate that professional identity transformation during crises involves navigating universal dialectical tensions while addressing existential challenges of meaning and purpose. Psychologists adaptively integrated reflective practices, digital competencies, and self-care strategies. The study contributes to professional identity literature by demonstrating that crises serve as catalysts for comprehensive identity transformation, fostering more adaptive, reflective, and resilient professional identities through resolving both practical contradictions and existential uncertainties.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在COVID-19大流行、数字化加速和乌克兰战争等危机时期，心理学家专业身份如何被塑造。研究发现心理学家通过应对实践矛盾和存在主义张力，实现了专业身份的适应性转变，包括整合反思实践、数字能力和自我照顾策略。
AI.research_question: 在COVID-19大流行、数字化加速和乌克兰战争等危机时期，心理学家的专业身份如何被塑造？
AI.motivation: 理解在多重危机（疫情、数字化、战争）背景下，心理学家如何应对实践矛盾和存在主义张力，以及这些经历如何影响其专业身份的形成和转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 存在主义-辩证框架，关注心理学家在广泛破坏中如何应对涉及意义、目的和专业重要性的实践矛盾和存在主义张力。
AI.method: 定性研究，包括45名经验丰富的拉脱维亚心理学家（平均年龄47.13岁，87%为女性），通过2022年10-11月进行的半结构化访谈收集数据，采用反思性主题分析法。
AI.findings: 识别出五个主题：1）传统实践与危机驱动变革的调和；2）情绪脆弱性与专业责任的平衡；3）通过强化监督和同伴支持应对孤立与协作；4）通过创造性和功能性适应发展专业实践；5）在初始不确定性中通过加强承诺实现专业成长。
AI.theory_contributions: 为专业身份文献做出贡献，证明危机作为全面身份转变的催化剂，通过解决实践矛盾和存在主义不确定性，培养更具适应性、反思性和韧性的专业身份。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了心理学家如何适应性整合反思实践、数字能力和自我照顾策略，为危机时期专业发展提供实践指导。

title: Platform Certification and Seller Disclosure in Online Selling
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Shenzhen University and Hong Kong Polytechnic University

detail.title: Platform Certification and Seller Disclosure in Online Selling
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Concern about product quality due to the inability to experience products physically has been a major factor that hinders consumers from purchasing online. To ease such concerns, online platforms and sellers have been engaged in various activities to reveal product quality information. Platform can provide certification to products sold via its marketplace, while sellers can voluntarily disclose their private quality information. Despite platform certification and seller disclosure being prevalent quality information revelation methods, the interaction between them has been seldom examined. In this study, we develop a game-theoretical model to analytically explore the implications of platform certification and seller disclosure in an online selling context. Methodology/results: We consider a continuum of sellers offering new products to end consumers through an online platform under one of two pricing schemes: (1) pay-per-transaction (commission fees) or (2) pay-per-listing (listing fees). Consumers hold prior beliefs about product quality and update them based on the observed platform certification and seller disclosure behavior. Our analysis shows that under the commission fee scheme, platform certification serves an informational role by influencing sellers' disclosure strategies and enhancing consumers' ability to infer quality. Platform certification always benefits the platform but may either benefit or hurt sellers, depending on their quality levels. Under the listing fee scheme, platform certification instead serves an enrollment role: the platform sets a certification standard to enhance consumers' quality expectation towards nondisclosure sellers, thereby encouraging more sellers to participate in online selling. In this case, platform certification continues to benefit the platform but does not affect sellers' disclosure behavior or profitability. We further demonstrate that our main findings remain robust across various alternative model specifications. Managerial implications: Our analysis reveals that the interplay between platform certification and seller disclosure generates non-trivial effects for both platforms and sellers. Platforms should carefully design its certification strategies in alignment with pricing structures, while sellers should adjust their disclosure strategies in response to platform certification decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过博弈论模型分析在线平台认证与卖家信息披露的互动关系，发现在不同定价机制下平台认证发挥不同作用：佣金模式下发挥信息作用影响卖家披露策略，而列表费模式下发挥准入作用影响卖家参与度。
AI.research_question: 在线销售环境中，平台认证与卖家信息披露如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 在线购物因无法实体体验产品而存在质量担忧，平台认证和卖家信息披露是常见的质量信息揭示方法，但两者间的互动关系鲜有研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，消费者基于平台认证和卖家披露行为更新质量信念。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，考虑连续分布的卖家通过在线平台销售新产品，分析两种定价机制（佣金费、列表费）下的均衡策略。
AI.findings: 佣金模式下平台认证影响卖家披露策略，平台总是受益但卖家可能受益或受损；列表费模式下平台认证影响卖家参与度，不影响卖家披露行为或利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析平台认证与卖家信息披露的互动关系，揭示不同定价机制下平台认证的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计认证策略和卖家调整披露策略提供管理启示，强调定价结构与认证策略的协调重要性。

title: Minimum Wages and Employment
affiliations: Arizona State University W. P. Carey School of Business and  Arizona State University (ASU), W.P. Carey School of Business, Students

detail.title: Minimum Wages and Employment
detail.abstract: Minimum wages do not necessarily cause a reduction in employment as fundamental microeconomics principles suggest. In the food and agriculture industry, minimum wages may be important tools to not only address income inequalities, but to increase the quantity of labor supplied and potentially help solve chronic labor shortages. While there are many possible explanations for the paradox of minimum wage neutrality, from correcting for monopsony power to segmented labor markets, we examine a relatively new and important mechanism. Namely, we test for whether minimum wages have a "cleansing" effect in industries that tend to employ minimum-wage workers, driving relatively inefficient firms, or those that could only survive by paying workers low wages, out of the industry. Exiting firms cede market share to more efficient firms, who employ the workers that are released by the exiting firms. We examine this question using a two-stage approach, first using reduced-form methods in aggregate data from the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) and then using micro-level data on individual firms in the retail industry from NielsenIQ TDLinx data set. We find broad support for the cleansing hypothesis in both the aggregate and micro-level analyses, suggesting that minimum wages may have a beneficial efficiency-enhancing effect that has otherwise been overlooked in the policy literature.

AI.tldr: 最低工资不一定导致就业减少，反而可能通过淘汰低效企业、让高效企业获得市场份额，从而产生"净化效应"，提高行业效率。
AI.research_question: 最低工资是否在雇佣最低工资工人的行业中具有"净化效应"，即淘汰相对低效的企业？
AI.motivation: 传统微观经济学认为最低工资会减少就业，但现实中存在最低工资中性悖论，需要探索新的解释机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最低工资的"净化效应"理论：最低工资可能淘汰只能靠支付低工资生存的低效企业，让高效企业获得市场份额。
AI.method: 两阶段方法：首先使用QCEW汇总数据进行简化形式分析，然后使用NielsenIQ TDLinx零售业微观企业数据进行微观层面分析。
AI.findings: 在汇总和微观层面分析中都广泛支持净化假说，表明最低工资可能具有有益的效率提升效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了最低工资"净化效应"的新理论机制，为最低工资中性悖论提供了新的解释视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了新的视角，表明最低工资可能不仅是解决收入不平等的工具，还能通过淘汰低效企业提升行业效率。

detail.abstract: Industry dimension is increasingly dominant to investigate the upward trend of inequality. This paper examines the key drivers of U.S. wage inequality through a general equilibrium model, emphasising the role of heterogeneous capital-labour substitution elasticities across industries in shaping wage dispersion. Key is the distinction of a quantity effect (changes in the composition of capital and labour inputs) and a structural effect (reflecting technological transformations in inputs substitutability) from Skill-Biased Technological Change (SBTC). Findings suggest that industry-level transformations on the labour sidedifferentials in job tasks substitutability and workforce compositionconstitute the principal drivers of real wage inequality, overshadowing the contribution of capital-side adjustments. A structural estimation of the model reveals that trend-asymmetries in the elasticities of substitution between ICT capital, routine and non-routine workers account for 94% of observed wage variance, while stronger sorting and segregation effects further exacerbate such dispersion. Upon neutralising structural differences between industries, SBTC reckons merely 6-15% of the observed wage inequality.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一般均衡模型分析美国工资不平等的主要驱动因素，重点关注不同行业资本-劳动替代弹性的异质性作用。研究发现行业层面的劳动力侧转型（工作任务可替代性和劳动力构成的差异）是实际工资不平等的主要驱动因素，超过了资本侧调整的贡献。结构估计显示ICT资本、常规与非常规工人之间替代弹性的趋势不对称性解释了94%的工资方差，而更强的分类和隔离效应进一步加剧了这种分散。
AI.research_question: 美国工资不平等的主要驱动因素是什么？行业间异质性的资本-劳动替代弹性在塑造工资分散中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 行业维度在分析不平等上升趋势中日益重要，需要区分数量效应（资本和劳动投入构成变化）和结构效应（反映投入可替代性的技术转型）与技能偏向型技术变革（SBTC）的贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，强调行业间异质性的资本-劳动替代弹性；区分数量效应和结构效应；技能偏向型技术变革（SBTC）理论。
AI.method: 结构估计方法，通过一般均衡模型分析ICT资本、常规和非常规工人之间的替代弹性趋势不对称性。
AI.findings: 行业层面的劳动力侧转型（工作任务可替代性和劳动力构成差异）是实际工资不平等的主要驱动因素；ICT资本、常规与非常规工人之间替代弹性的趋势不对称性解释了94%的工资方差；更强的分类和隔离效应进一步加剧工资分散。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了区分数量效应和结构效应的理论框架；强调了行业间异质性在解释工资不平等中的关键作用；挑战了传统SBTC理论的主导地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精确的工资不平等驱动因素分析；强调了劳动力市场结构性改革的重要性；有助于设计更有效的收入分配政策。

title: Coalition Government in South Africa: The Political Solution
affiliations: Durban University of Technology, Durban University of Technology, University of South Africa (UNISA) and University of South Africa (UNISA)

detail.title: Coalition Government in South Africa: The Political Solution
detail.abstract:
This paper explores coalition government in South Africa as a potential solution to governance challenges in a diverse society. As the nation faces political fragmentation, economic inequality, and social unrest, traditional party politics often fall short of addressing citizen needs. The study argues that coalition governments offer a more inclusive framework, fostering collaboration among various political parties and interest groups.

The research examines the historical context of coalition politics in South Africa, particularly in the post-apartheid political landscape. This paper analyses recent electoral trends leading to increased party fragmentation, where no single party secures an outright majority, necessitating coalition formation through negotiated agreements among diverse political actors.

Using thirty-one relevant articles on historical precedents from 2001 - 2025, current trends, and case studies of coalition governments at national and provincial levels, the paper assesses the benefits and challenges of this governance model. Successful examples illustrate how coalitions can facilitate inclusive policymaking and improve service delivery, while potential pitfalls include instability and conflicting agendas among partners.

Additionally, the study discusses the role of civil society and community engagement in supporting coalition governments, emphasizing transparency, accountability, and public participation in decision-making. In conclusion, the paper posits that coalition government may be a viable political solution for South Africa, addressing the complexities of its multifaceted society. By fostering cooperation among diverse political actors, coalitions can enhance governance, promote social cohesion, and contribute to a more equitable and democratic South Africa. The findings aim to inform policymakers, political analysts, and stakeholders about the transformative potential of coalition governance in the country

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management and Statistics Working Paper No. 559
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Milan Bicocca Department of Economics, Management & Statistics Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Complementarities in intermediate inputs trigger the even transmission of asymmetric shocks in production networks. This paper linearly captures these complementarities through shared inter-sectoral trade relationships, and makes two novel contributions to the understanding of networked economies. First, it introduces a theoretical framework that distinguishes between factor input demand and factor input supply network distances, measuring economic distance between sectors based on common upstream sellers or downstream buyers. These horizontal interdependencies determine how sector-specific shocks transmit horizontally across the network, complementing and balancing the standard vertical (Leontief inverse) mechanism. Second, using sector-level U.S. employment data, the paper provides empirical evidence that positive employment shocks in closely demand-or supply-connected sectors are attenuated, whereas larger distances generate employment comovement. Together, these two contributions reveal that the horizontal geometry of a production network plays a critical role in understanding how sectoral interactions propagate micro-originated shocks in an Input-Output economy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过共享的跨部门贸易关系线性捕捉中间投入品的互补性，对网络化经济理解做出两个新贡献：一是区分要素投入需求和供给网络距离的理论框架，二是使用美国就业数据实证证明紧密需求或供给关联部门的就业冲击会被削弱，而较大距离产生就业联动。

AI.theory_contributions: 引入区分需求和供给网络距离的理论框架，揭示水平相互依赖关系如何补充标准垂直传播机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了生产网络水平几何结构在理解部门互动如何传播微观起源冲击中的关键作用。

detail.title: Research on RA 9003: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
detail.abstract:
Abstract

This paper discusses Republic Act No. 9003, also known as the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, which serves as a major environmental law in the Philippines. Enacted to promote proper waste management, the law emphasizes shared responsibility among individuals, communities, and government agencies in reducing, segregating, and disposing of waste properly. It sets clear objectives: protecting public health, raising environmental awareness, and promoting recycling and ecological practices such as composting and segregation at the source.

The study outlines key provisions, including waste segregation, the establishment of Materials Recovery Facilities (MRFs), the prohibition of harmful waste disposal practices, and the enforcement of penalties for violations. It also highlights the role of the National Solid Waste Management Commission and the requirement for local governments to create 10-year waste management plans.

Despite its significance, the paper notes that implementation remains a challenge due to weak enforcement, lack of funding, and limited public participation. Strengthening community involvement, improving facilities, and enforcing the law more strictly are identified as essential steps toward success. Ultimately, RA 9003 is a vital tool for achieving sustainable development and ensuring a cleaner and healthier environment for future generations.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了菲律宾《2000年生态固体废物管理法》(RA 9003)，探讨了该法律在促进适当废物管理方面的规定、实施挑战以及改进建议。

detail.title: Convergence
detail.abstract:
In recent years, the United States has mobilized a vast regulatory machine to stunt China’s growth and curb its competitiveness. Departing from prevailing economic and political science literature that examines why the United States seeks to contain China, this Article investigates how it pursues that objective and, crucially, what consequences these strategies have produced. Drawing on systems theory, it offers the first comprehensive account of the institutional pattern underpinning the legal architecture governing U.S. restrictions on trade, technology, data, and talent flows with China.

A central insight is convergence: in seeking to curb China’s rise, the United States has increasingly come to resemble its rival across three core dimensions of regulatory governance: structure, process, and outcome. Structurally, decision-making has become increasingly concentrated in the executive branch, which has stretched the boundaries of statutory authority through novel and expansive interpretations. Procedurally, policymaking has grown volatile—driven as much by partisan and personal interests as by shifting calculations of national interest. These dynamics have produced mixed results, while noisy market signals have delayed meaningful feedback about policy effectiveness.

This Article also advances a theory of convergence that explains the dynamic interactions between the two great powers. In response to strong domestic demand for tougher measures toward China, U.S. presidents adopt sweeping precautionary measures with limited cost–benefit analysis; those measures, in turn, intensify demand and generate powerful institutional momentum toward further containment. Beijing doubles down on self-sufficiency, narrowing technological gaps despite severe U.S. restrictions. As China grows more resilient, it demonstrates greater capacity and resolve to mount aggressive retaliation. Chinese countermeasures prompt the executive to undertake unprecedented, intrusive state intervention, further entrenching the expansion of presidential power.

As a result, absent a fundamental reorientation of the constitutional order governing foreign affairs and national security, U.S. legal containment will only accelerate convergence with China—a trajectory that carries profound implications not only for the future of U.S.–China rivalry but also for the United States’ own constitutional order.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国如何通过法律架构遏制中国发展，发现两国在监管治理上出现收敛现象：结构上决策权集中于行政部门，程序上政策制定变得波动，结果上产生混合效果。作者提出收敛理论解释两国互动动态，并警告这种趋势对美国宪法秩序有深远影响。
AI.research_question: 美国如何通过法律架构遏制中国发展？这些策略产生了什么后果？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注美国为何要遏制中国，而本文旨在探究其具体实施方式和产生的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统理论、收敛理论
AI.method: 制度模式分析，考察美国在贸易、技术、数据和人才流动方面的法律架构
AI.findings: 美国在遏制中国过程中，在监管治理的结构、过程和结果三个维度上与中国趋同；这种收敛趋势对美国宪法秩序构成威胁
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了收敛理论，解释中美两大国之间的动态互动关系
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了美国遏制策略的实际效果有限，反而加速了与中国的制度趋同；为政策制定者提供警示

title: Special Conference Calls
affiliations: New York Institute of Technology and Wayne State University - Mike Ilitch School of Business

detail.title: Special Conference Calls
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants, content, and consequences of special conference calls. Special conference calls, meetings held by publicly-traded companies in which executives provide an overview of specific events related to the firm, have increased in frequency by 375% since the COVID-19 pandemic. Using 11,692 special calls held by U.S. public firms from 2005 to 2022, we find that hosting decisions are related to firm-level uncertainty and investor information demand. Firms that are larger, covered by more analysts, and operating in more complex business segments are more likely to hold these events. Equity markets treat special calls as incrementally informative relative to 8-Ks, with significantly positive abnormal returns and trading volume. Textual analysis of transcripts using latent Dirichlet allocation identifies four main topics: customer and growth discussions, strategic outcomes, biotech-related business updates, and clinical trial announcements. Market reactions differ across topics, with positive responses to growth and negative responses to trial announcements. A robustness analysis using BERTopic confirms these findings. Overall, special calls represent an important discretionary disclosure channel.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，特殊电话会议作为上市公司的重要自愿披露渠道，在新冠疫情期间频率激增375%。这些会议具有增量信息价值，市场反应因讨论主题而异，其中增长讨论获积极反应，临床试验公告获消极反应。
AI.research_question: 特殊电话会议的决定因素、内容和后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 特殊电话会议作为上市公司就特定事件与投资者沟通的会议，自新冠疫情以来频率增加了375%，但其决定因素、内容和市场反应尚未得到系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息披露理论和投资者信息需求理论，探讨公司自愿披露行为的决定因素和市场反应。
AI.method: 使用2005-2022年间美国上市公司11,692次特殊电话会议数据，结合事件研究法、文本分析（LDA和BERTopic）和回归分析。
AI.findings: 1）举办决策与公司不确定性和投资者信息需求相关；2）规模大、分析师覆盖多、业务复杂的公司更可能举办；3）市场将其视为相对于8-K文件的增量信息；4）识别出四大主题：客户与增长讨论、战略成果、生物技术业务更新、临床试验公告；5）市场反应因主题而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对公司自愿披露行为决定因素的理解，揭示了特殊电话会议作为重要披露渠道的理论意义。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了评估特殊电话会议信息价值的方法，为公司管理层优化信息披露策略提供参考。

title: Behavioral Finance and Investor Psychology in Volatile Markets: Insights into Decision-Making, Biases, and Market Dynamics
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: Behavioral Finance and Investor Psychology in Volatile Markets: Insights into Decision-Making, Biases, and Market Dynamics
detail.abstract: This study examines the influence of behavioral biases on investor decision-making within financial markets, particularly under conditions of volatility and uncertainty. It synthesizes insights from behavioral finance, psychology, neuroscience, and sociology to elucidate how cognitive heuristics, emotional responses, and social dynamics contribute to market inefficiencies and price anomalies. Key biases such as loss aversion, overconfidence, anchoring, availability, and herd behavior are analyzed in the context of their amplification during turbulent periods, with attention to cultural and regional variations. The work explores the interplay between individual psychological factors and collective phenomena, including contagion and synchronized trading patterns, highlighting the role of information dissemination through digital platforms and social media. It further discusses mitigation strategies encompassing investor education, decision-support tools, structured investment approaches, and regulatory interventions informed by behavioral principles. The integration of neuroscientific findings offers a biological perspective on the mechanisms underlying these biases, informing the design of more effective models and policies. The paper also addresses ethical considerations related to exploiting behavioral tendencies and emphasizes the responsibilities of financial advisors in guiding clients through complex market environments. Overall, the research provides a comprehensive framework for understanding and managing the behavioral dimensions of investment, with implications for enhancing market stability and investor outcomes across diverse global contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了行为偏差对金融市场中投资者决策的影响，特别是在波动和不确定条件下。整合了行为金融学、心理学、神经科学和社会学的见解，分析了认知启发法、情绪反应和社会动态如何导致市场无效性和价格异常。
AI.research_question: 行为偏差如何影响金融市场中的投资者决策，特别是在波动和不确定条件下？
AI.motivation: 理解行为偏差在金融市场中的作用对于提高市场效率和投资者收益至关重要，特别是在动荡时期这些偏差会被放大。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、心理学、神经科学和社会学的整合框架，包括认知启发法、情绪反应和社会动态理论。
AI.method: 综合文献分析，整合多个学科领域的见解，分析关键行为偏差及其在动荡时期的表现。
AI.findings: 损失厌恶、过度自信、锚定效应、可得性偏差和羊群行为等关键偏差在动荡时期会被放大，并受到文化、区域差异和数字平台信息传播的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了理解行为偏差如何导致市场无效性和价格异常的综合性理论框架，整合了神经科学对偏差生物机制的见解。

title: Nice Work if You Can Get it? The Distribution of Employment and Earnings during the Early Years of the Clean Energy Transition *
affiliations: University of Virginia, U.S. Census Bureau and U.S. Census Bureau

detail.title: Nice Work if You Can Get it? The Distribution of Employment and Earnings during the Early Years of the Clean Energy Transition *
detail.abstract: The transition to clean energy represents a fundamental and important shift in economic activity. We present new facts about workers in clean and legacy energy sectors between 2005 and 2019 using linked, administrative employer-employee data for all W-2 workers in the United States. We show that both clean and legacy energy establishments hire a disproportionate share of non-Hispanic White and male workers compared to the working population, that workers rarely move from legacy to clean firms, and that, conditional on education, workers do not earn more in clean firms than in legacy firms. The occupational categories of jobs at clean firms differ notably from occupations at legacy firms and, on average, tend to be performed by workers with higher levels of education. Regional overlap in employment opportunities is not sufficient to facilitate worker transitions from legacy to clean firms. Substantially lower earnings outside of the energy sector combined with low mobility between legacy and clean firms suggests that the costs of the clean transition on workers in legacy fossil fuel sectors may be substantial. At the same time workers moving into clean activities from outside of the energy sector experience significant increases in earnings and greater job stability, suggesting that clean jobs are "good jobs" for those who can access them.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用美国2005-2019年所有W-2工人的雇主-雇员关联数据，分析了清洁能源和传统能源行业的劳动力市场特征。研究发现两个行业都过度雇佣白人和男性工人，工人很少从传统能源转向清洁能源公司，且教育程度相同时，清洁能源公司的薪酬并不更高。清洁能源转型对传统化石燃料行业工人可能造成重大成本，但对从外部进入清洁能源行业的工人来说，清洁能源工作提供了更好的收入和稳定性。
AI.research_question: 清洁能源转型如何影响劳动力市场？清洁能源和传统能源行业在工人特征、流动性和薪酬方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 清洁能源转型是经济活动的重要转变，但对其劳动力市场影响的理解有限。需要了解工人如何在清洁和传统能源部门之间流动，以及这种转型对工人福利的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场流动理论、职业转型理论、能源转型经济学
AI.method: 使用2005-2019年美国所有W-2工人的行政雇主-雇员关联数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 1) 清洁和传统能源企业都过度雇佣白人和男性工人；2) 工人很少从传统转向清洁能源公司；3) 教育程度相同时，清洁能源公司薪酬不更高；4) 清洁能源工作教育要求更高；5) 地区就业机会重叠不足以促进工人转型；6) 从外部进入清洁能源的工人收入显著增加且工作更稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了清洁能源转型对劳动力市场影响的实证证据，揭示了工人流动障碍和转型成本，丰富了能源转型经济学理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了清洁能源转型对工人影响的量化证据，建议需要针对性政策来支持传统能源工人转型，同时促进清洁能源就业机会的公平获取

title: NavSense:Real-Time Spatial Awareness for the Visually Impaired Using LiDAR, Depth Cameras, and AI-based object detection
affiliations: K.J. Somaiya College of Engineering Somaiya Vidyavihar University, K. J. Somaiya College of Engineering and University of Mumbai - K. J. Somaiya College of Engineering (K.J.S.C.E.)

detail.title: NavSense:Real-Time Spatial Awareness for the Visually Impaired Using LiDAR, Depth Cameras, and AI-based object detection
detail.abstract: Indoor navigation poses immense challenges for visually impaired people in terms of requiring real-time spatial perception and obstacle detection for safe and independent mobility. This work proposes a state-of-the-art multimodal sensor fusion indoor navigation system consisting of YD LiDAR for 360 °horizontal mapping, two TF-Luna LiDARs for localized distance measurement, an Intel RealSense D435i depth camera to enable 3D spatial awareness and RGB imaging and AI-based object detection. The main indoor landmarks such as doors, stairs, exit signs, and people are identified by a custom YOLOv5-based neural network, ensuring intelligent decision making for navigation. The system integrates depth, LiDAR, and RGB inputs to create an intelligent real-time obstacle detection model that identifies potential hazards. A text-to-speech (TTS) feedback mechanism offers adaptive audio feedback aimed at enabling high-priority presentation of critical warnings (e.g. near collisions) over general navigational announcements. The architecture incorporates a training framework that aims to constantly reduce object detection error by accumulating labeled data and optimizing models. This proposed system offers real-time hands-free guidance, with the addition of multisensor fusion, deep learning, and adaptive auditory feedback making it easier to navigate unfamiliar indoor spaces. By blending data from multiple sensors, it improves environmental awareness, empowering visually impaired users to move safely and independently. Future work will show the application of Edge AI, adaptive learning models, and user adaptability to facilitate greater practical usability. This work will help advance AI-driven assistive technology towards next-generation smart mobility solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多模态传感器融合的室内导航系统，结合激光雷达、深度相机和AI目标检测，为视障人士提供实时障碍物检测和语音导航反馈。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够为视障人士提供安全独立室内导航的多模态传感器融合系统？
AI.motivation: 视障人士在室内导航中面临实时空间感知和障碍物检测的挑战，需要智能系统来支持其独立行动能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多传感器融合理论、深度学习目标检测和自适应反馈机制。
AI.method: 采用YD LiDAR进行360°水平映射，两个TF-Luna LiDAR用于局部距离测量，Intel RealSense D435i深度相机实现3D空间感知，结合自定义YOLOv5神经网络进行目标检测。
AI.findings: 系统能够实时识别门、楼梯、出口标志和行人等关键室内地标，通过多传感器融合提高环境感知能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合多模态传感器融合、深度学习和自适应听觉反馈的室内导航理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了免手持实时导航系统，通过文本转语音反馈机制提供关键警告，帮助视障人士在陌生室内环境中安全独立移动。

title: Deep Analysis of the Balanced Free Trade Model with Quota System: Expanding on a Smarter Alternative to Tariffs for American Growth

detail.title: Deep Analysis of the Balanced Free Trade Model with Quota System: Expanding on a Smarter Alternative to Tariffs for American Growth

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to influence the research or conclusions of this paper. The study was conducted independently and without institutional affiliation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research does not involve human subjects or data requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All analysis and preparation were completed independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper provides a detailed analysis of the Balanced Free Trade Model with Quota System (BFT Model), expanding on the author’s original policy study, Balanced Free Trade Model with Quota System: A Smarter Alternative to Tariffs for American Growth [1]. Developed as a novel framework by the author, the BFT Model offers a lawful and economically efficient replacement for tariff-based trade policy. Whereas tariffs impose hidden taxes on American consumers, fuel inflation, and fail to eliminate trade deficits, the BFT Model directly addresses structural imbalances by requiring surplus countries to purchase quota rights equivalent to their surpluses. This mechanism ensures balanced trade, stable consumer prices, and substantial federal revenue without shifting costs onto U.S. families. Through historical data, legal analysis, and case studies of recent U.S. trade agreements with Japan and the European Union [3][4], this paper demonstrates why tariffs have consistently failed and why the BFT Model presents a superior alternative for sustainable American growth.

AI.tldr: 本文详细分析了带有配额制度的平衡自由贸易模型（BFT模型），该模型作为关税贸易政策的合法且经济高效替代方案，通过要求顺差国购买与其顺差相当的配额权来直接解决结构性失衡问题。
AI.research_question: BFT模型如何作为关税贸易政策的替代方案，更有效地解决贸易失衡问题并促进美国可持续增长？

AI.method: 历史数据分析、法律分析、美国与日本和欧盟贸易协议的案例研究
AI.findings: BFT模型能够确保贸易平衡、稳定消费者价格并产生大量联邦收入，而不会将成本转嫁给美国家庭
